Magic has had some references to Star Trek before the set's release.
paragraphs.section: Earlier Star Trek references in Magic

paragraphs.text: Several of the pre- Alpha playtest cards , such as the Gamma versions of Blessing and Righteousness , featured images of Star Trek characters.
paragraphs.section: Earlier Star Trek references in Magic

paragraphs.text: The series of codenames for the Zendikar block was Long, Live and Prosper. This is part of the Vulcan salute .
paragraphs.section: Earlier Star Trek references in Magic

paragraphs.text: The borderless Dominaria Remastered version of Siege-Gang Commander features a Redshirt reference in its flavor text .
paragraphs.section: Earlier Star Trek references in Magic

paragraphs.text: The infestation of Beebles in Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun ( Bamboozling Beeble ) is reminiscent of the Tribble of Star Trek .
paragraphs.section: Earlier Star Trek references in Magic

paragraphs.text: At both Gen Con 2025 and MagicCon Atlanta 2025 the Unknown Event included a set teaser in the form of Pirk, Heroic Captain , a parody of William Shatner 's Captain James T. Kirk .
paragraphs.section: Earlier Star Trek references in Magic

paragraphs.text: For the MagicCon Las Vegas 2025 Planechase Unknown event , five Rank cards were designed and given out to players at a party held at AREA15 on the Thursday night before the MagicCon. Each rank references an associated rank from the Star Trek franchise.
